title: Amazon says its business sales unit, Amazon Business, reached $60B in annualized gross sales in Q2, up ~71% from 2023, and serves 11M+ organizations worldwide (Matt Day/Bloomberg)
summary: Matt Day / Bloomberg: Amazon says its business sales unit, Amazon Business, reached $60B in annualized gross sales in Q2, up ~71% from 2023, and serves 11M+ organizations worldwide — Amazon.com Inc.'s business sales unit was recently on track to sell $60 billion of merchandise over the course of a full year …
